podSecurityContext.description: A Kubernetes PodSecurityContext. Every field accepts null, which removes the default.

containerSecurityContext.description: A Kubernetes SecurityContext for a container. Every field accepts null, which removes the default.

global.description: Set by a parent chart and passed to every subchart. This chart reads nothing from it. Values for extraObjects templates and YAML anchors can live here.

enabled.description: Set by a parent chart's dependency condition. This chart does not read it.

tag.description: n8n image tag. Leave empty to use the chart's appVersion

digest.description: n8n image digest. When set, the image is pulled by digest and tag is ignored

imagePullSecrets.description: Existing pull Secrets for private image registries, referenced by every n8n pod and the Helm test pod

keyTtl.description: Time to live (in seconds) for leader key in multi-main setup

checkInterval.description: Interval (in seconds) for leader check in multi-main setup

tag.description: Task runner image tag. Leave empty to use the same tag as the main n8n image

digest.description: Task runner image digest. When set, the runner image is pulled by digest and tag is ignored

mode.description: Task runner mode (only external is supported)

value.description: Retired. Set secretRefs.env.N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN, or add N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN to the Secret in secretRefs.existingSecret.

listenAddress.description: Retired. Remove it; the broker listens on localhost. For a runner outside the pod, set N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_LISTEN_ADDRESS in env.worker, or in env.main in standalone mode.

probes.description: Probes against the launcher's health endpoint in the task-runner sidecar

workerConcurrency.description: Jobs each worker runs at once, passed as --concurrency. Null uses n8n's default.

webhook.description: A second Ingress for webhook traffic. With hosts, webhooks get hosts of their own; without, it shares ingress.hosts and renders only with webhook processors.

httpRoute.description: A Gateway API HTTPRoute to main, and to the webhook processors for the webhook paths. The chart never creates the Gateway.

parentRefs.description: The Gateways the route attaches to. Required when enabled.

hostnames.description: Hostnames the route matches. The first one sets the editor URL when editor.url is empty.

webhook.description: A second HTTPRoute for webhook hosts of their own, carrying the webhook paths only.

hostnames.description: Webhook hostnames. The first one sets the webhook URL when webhook.url is empty.

parentRefs.description: The Gateways the webhook route attaches to. Empty uses httpRoute.parentRefs.

nodePlacement.description: Component-specific pod node placement values. Non-empty component values override the global nodeSelector, tolerations, and affinity values.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod securityContext. Each role block merges over shared field by field and wins over it. A null removes a field.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext. Each role block merges over shared field by field and wins over it. A null removes a field. taskRunner applies to the task-runner sidecar on main and worker pods.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount the ServiceAccount token into n8n pods. n8n does not call the Kubernetes API.

extraInitContainers.description: Additional init containers prepended to main, worker, and webhook-processor pods. Entries with restartPolicy: Always are treated as K8s 1.29+ native sidecars.

dnsPolicy.description: Pod DNS policy applied to main, worker, and webhook-processor pods. Leave empty to use the cluster default.

dnsConfig.description: Pod DNS configuration applied to main, worker, and webhook-processor pods.

hostAliases.description: Extra /etc/hosts entries for main, worker, and webhook-processor pods.

create.description: Create a Role that reads ConfigMaps and Secrets in the namespace, bound to the ServiceAccount. n8n does not use it.

strategy.description: Update strategy for the main Deployment. Empty uses Recreate for ReadWriteOnce persistence, and the Kubernetes default otherwise.

enableServiceLinks.description: Inject <SERVICE>_SERVICE_HOST, <SERVICE>_PORT and related variables for every Service in the namespace into n8n pods. n8n reads none of them.

ingress.description: NetworkPolicy ingress rules. When set, they replace the chart's ingress rules. Empty allows the release's own pods and any source on service.port.

egress.description: NetworkPolicy egress rules. When set, they replace the chart's egress rules. Empty allows all egress.

pause.description: Pause KEDA autoscaling, freezing workers at their current replica count (autoscaling.keda.sh/paused).

pausedReplicaCount.description: Optional replica count to hold while KEDA autoscaling is paused (autoscaling.keda.sh/paused-replicas). Unset freezes workers at their current count.

pollingInterval.description: How often KEDA checks the triggers, in seconds.

cooldownPeriod.description: Wait before scaling back down to minReplicaCount, in seconds.

pause.description: Pause KEDA autoscaling, freezing webhook processors at their current replica count (autoscaling.keda.sh/paused).

pausedReplicaCount.description: Optional replica count to hold while KEDA autoscaling is paused (autoscaling.keda.sh/paused-replicas). Unset freezes webhook processors at their current count.

pollingInterval.description: How often KEDA checks the triggers, in seconds.

cooldownPeriod.description: Wait before scaling back down to minReplicaCount, in seconds.

extraEnv.description: Retired. Set env.main and env.webhookProcessor instead.

timeout.description: Retired. Remove it. n8n has no setting for a webhook timeout.

url.description: Public base URL of the editor, rendered as N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL. Webhooks follow it unless webhook.url is set. Empty uses https:// and the first ingress host or route hostname.

extraEnv.description: Retired. Set env.main and env.worker instead.

extraObjects.description: Additional Kubernetes objects rendered as part of the Helm release. Each entry is a map or a YAML string, and is passed through Helm tpl

extraVolumes.description: Additional volumes for main, worker, and webhook-processor pods

extraVolumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts for the n8n container in main, worker, and webhook-processor pods

extraContainers.description: Additional containers (sidecars) for main, worker, and webhook-processor pods

env.description: Environment variables per component. Literals are rendered into ConfigMaps loaded with envFrom. References (secretKeyRef, configMapKeyRef, fieldRef, resourceFieldRef) go in the container's env list.

chartEnvOverrides.description: Replacements for variables the chart sets, per component.

envFrom.description: ConfigMaps and Secrets loaded whole with envFrom, per component, after the chart's ConfigMaps.

N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE.description: Absolute path of a mounted encryption key file. When set, n8n containers read the key from this file instead of N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY

N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Task-runner auth token for the chart-managed Secret. With secretRefs.existingSecret, put the token in that Secret instead

type.description: postgresdb connects to your PostgreSQL. sqlite keeps the database on the PersistentVolumeClaim, in standalone mode only.

useExternal.description: Retired. Use database.type. The render fails while this key is set.

key.description: Retired. Set database.ssl.existingSecret.name and database.ssl.existingSecret.keyKey instead.

useExternal.description: Retired. Nothing replaces it. The render fails while this key is set.

mode.description: Retired. Remove it; s3.enabled sets the binary data mode.

then.errorMessage: ingress.enabled=true requires at least one hosts[] entry
database.type=postgresdb requires host, port, database, user and passwordSecret
database.type=sqlite runs in standalone mode only, so queueMode and multiMain must be disabled
s3.enabled=true requires bucket configuration and either autoDetect=true or explicit credentials
